text:
FLOWTABLE::limit
Description
This iRules command returns configured connection limits
Syntax
FLOWTABLE
::
limit
virtual
<
virtual-name
>
FLOWTABLE
::
limit
route_domain
<
route-domain
>
FLOWTABLE::limit virtual <virtual-name>
This command returns the configured connection limit for a given
virtual server.
FLOWTABLE::limit route_domain <route-domain>
This command returns the configured connection limit for a given
route domain.
